title: Synth's Strategy: Vertex of Power
summary: Our protagonist, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, envisions a daring strategy. Overlooking an idyllic valley, she tests a nifty synth, hoping her ingenuity will greenlight a lottery of grand proportions, despite the skeptical faculty. Surviving the rocky grasslands, she navigates past abandoned kettles, a faint whistle foreshadowing trouble. An anthro archer overtook her, forcing her to repack and press on. Reaching a massive haycock, she grumbles about her bad luck. The baffling power of the ultimates had conjured a vertex of raw physic energy. With a triumphant fanfare, she finds true empowerment, the old world's issues banished. From a high archway, she surveys a world transformed. She had vacked the old system, exploiting a crucial typo, her cocky confidence leading to new northern landings. Her calculated torque gently knocks a new era into place.
